# Aqua Haven (أكوا هيفن)

> Aqua Haven designs, builds, and maintains premium freshwater and marine aquariums across Saudi Arabia — custom tanks, professional maintenance plans, and business solutions for cafes, restaurants, and retail spaces.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Aqua Haven's aquarium design and maintenance services.
- [About](/about): Company story, team, and craftsmanship approach.
- [Services](/services): Full list of aquarium services offered.
- [Custom Aquariums](/services/custom-aquariums): Bespoke aquarium design and fabrication.
- [Maintenance Plans](/maintenance): Monthly maintenance packages for freshwater and marine tanks.
- [Business Solutions](/business-solutions): Aquarium installations for cafes, restaurants, events, and shops.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Completed aquarium projects and case studies.
- [Catalog](/catalog): Available aquarium models and equipment.
- [Knowledge Center](/knowledge): Articles and guides on aquarium care.
- [Consultation](/consultation): Book a design or maintenance consultation.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with Aqua Haven.

## Optional

- [Trust & Privacy](/trust): Privacy and data handling practices.
